profile.headline: MBA | Software Engineer | Rochester Institute of Technology Alumni
profile.summary:
Software engineer and MBA grad from the Rochester Institute of Technology. Acquired an accelerated +1 MBA to combine my technical skills with business strategy. My hands-on experience spans from large organizations to tech startups, including internships at UPMC, MarketReader, and Lockerverse, as well as rising into a junior software engineer role at MarketReader.

I thrive in fast-paced environments, where I can leverage my experience in product development, software engineering, and problem-solving. As a startup enthusiast, I’m passionate about the creation and acceleration of innovative companies and how they will contribute to the tech ecosystem.

I’m always eager to connect with anyone in the software engineering, entrepreneurship, and venture capital industries to hear about opportunities/trends.
